|errata_history=This is the original printed text; the image is the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-03-Assassins_Blaster_Rifle.png]]). The later errata version is [[Assassin's Blaster Rifle (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet (official text as of 14 September 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 14, 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 October 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095520/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on your assassin; assassin is power +1. May target a character at same or adjacent site for free. Draw destiny. If destiny +1 > defense value: target hit, may not be captured this turn, and you may place a bounty on target in Used Pile to retrieve 2 Force.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-03-Assassins_Blaster_Rifle.png]]) prints it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 58) prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Assassin's Blaster Rifle (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 12 December 2012 and in the capture of 11 January 2013) changed “Deploy on your assassin” to “Deploy on an assassin” and dropped “this turn” (“may not be captured,”)<ref name="cl-1282_11-2012-12-12">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive); the same text in the capture of 11 January 2013 (the card is not in the capture of 21 July 2012)</ref>: “Deploy on an assassin; assassin is power +1. May target a character at same or adjacent site for free. Draw destiny. If destiny +1 > defense value: target hit, may not be captured, and you may place a bounty on target in Used Pile to retrieve 2 Force.” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-assassinsblasterrifle-pre.gif]], undated) prints it.
